# Data prep

filtering

```{r}
syssel %>% 
  map_levels()
```

```{r}
syssel_prep <- syssel %>% 
  filter(ALDER == "20_66",
         STILLINGSANDEL == "HELDELTID_TOT",
         AAR_end == max(AAR_end)) %>% 
  mutate(KJONN_tekst = case_when(KJONN == 0 ~ "Kjønn samlet",
                                 KJONN == 1 ~ "Menn",
                                 KJONN == 2 ~ "Kvinner",
                                 ),
         UTDANN_text = case_when(UTDANN == 0 ~ "Total",
                              UTDANN == 1 ~ "Grunnskole",
                              UTDANN == 2 ~ "Videregående",
                              UTDANN == 3 ~ "Høyere \nutdanning",
                              UTDANN == 4 ~ "Uoppgitt")) %>% 
  filter(UTDANN %in% c(1:3))

```

```{r}
syssel_plot <- left_join(jointable, syssel_prep) %>% 
  filter(GEO_type %in% c("land", "fylke", "kommune")) %>% 
  mutate(prikk = ifelse(is.na(MEIS), 3, NA_real_)) %>% 
  mutate(group = interaction(reorder(Sted, plotorder), reorder(KJONN_tekst, desc(KJONN)), sep = "\n"),
         ) %>% 
  mutate(plotid = ifelse(plotid == 3, "03", plotid),
         Sted = case_when(GEO == 301 ~ paste0(Sted, " (kommune)"),
                          GEO == 3 ~ paste0(Sted, " (fylke)"),
                          TRUE ~ Sted)) # ensure 4 digit Oslo geo code
```

# PLOT

## Test kommune 

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}

x_text_size <- 12
y_text_size <- 11.5
axis_title_size <- 14
legend_size <- 12
stripsize <- 14
ymax <- 100
ylab <- "Andel standardisert (prosent)"
kildelab <- "Kilde: SSB"

theme_OVP <- theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text = element_text(size = legend_size),
          legend.margin=margin(t=-6),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = x_text_size,
                                     #angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                     ),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = y_text_size),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = stripsize),
          line = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "grey50"),
          panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "grey50"),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust=c(0,1), size = c(5,10)),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 5, b = 2, l = 5),
          panel.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
          )

misstext <- "Manglende eller anonymiserte tall"

do_plot <- function(data, include_missing = FALSE) {  # default is missing FALSE, no need to speficy
    
  highest_plotorder <- data %>% filter(plotorder == max(plotorder)) %>% pull(Sted)

    p <- data %>% 
    filter(KJONN > 0,
           UTDANN > 0) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(UTDANN_text, UTDANN), 
               y = MEIS,
               fill = reorder(group,plotorder),
               
               )) +
    geom_col(aes(label = round(MEIS, 0),
               ),
             width = 0.7,
             position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors_4)) +
    #scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.5,1)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(MEIS, 0)),
              vjust = -0.6,
              position = position_dodge(0.7),
              size = 4,
              ) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.25, 0.25))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,100,10),
                       limits = c(0,100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,100),
                    #xlim = c(1,3),
                    clip = "off") +
  theme_OVP +
    labs(y = ylab,
         caption = c(syssel_data, kildelab),
         fill = "") +
    guides(alpha = FALSE) +
    facet_grid(~reorder(Sted, plotorder), scales = "free", space = "free")
  
   
   # If missing values should be visualized, add these layers
  if (include_missing) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(aes(y = prikk,
                     group = reorder(group, plotorder)), 
                     #group = reorder(Sted, plotorder)), 
                 color = "black", size = 4.1,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
       geom_text(data = data %>% filter(Sted == highest_plotorder),
              aes(label = misstext,
                     group = group),
                 x = 2,
                 y = 97,
                 size = 3.9,
                 check_overlap = TRUE,
                 inherit.aes = FALSE) +
       geom_point(data = data %>% filter(Sted == highest_plotorder),
              aes(group = group),
                  x = 0.75, y = 96.5,
                  size = 4,
                  inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  
  return(p)
}

syssel_plot %>% 
  filter(GEO_type %in% c("land", "fylke"),
         ) %>% 
  filter(plotid == "18") %>% 
  do_plot(., include_missing = FALSE)

```

# MULTIPLOT

```{r}
syssel_plot
```


```{r}
dirname <- "Figur3_FYLKE"
figposnr <- "4"

res_dir <- paste0("plots/", dirname)
dir.create(res_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Plot Level 1 - Plot kjønn - no missing
plots <- syssel_plot %>% 
  filter(GEO_type %in% c("land", "fylke"),
         ) %>% 
  #filter(plotid %in% nomiss) %>%
  split(.$plotid) %>% 
  map(~do_plot(.x, include_missing = FALSE))


# Combine both lists of plots
#all_plots <- c(plots_5)
#all_plots <- c(plots_1, plots_2, plots_3, plots_4)

# Generate file paths using `outdir` and `figposnr`
paths <- stringr::str_c(names(plots), "_", figposnr, "_tema", ".png")

# Save plots
pwalk(list(paths, plots), ~ggsave(filename = .x, plot = .y, 
                                      height = 5, width = 7, dpi = 200, bg = "white", 
                                      path = res_dir))
length(plots)
```
